title: Figure 12: Positron rocket fluid systems, four heating chamber/nozzle configurations
description: Four color schematics (a)-(d) of a positron rocket with a "Positron Trap" injecting e+ into a "HEATING CHAMBER" and "NOZZLE," with gamma-ray (γ) arrows radiating from the annihilation point. Variants show LN2 or Ne propellant, H2 with LXe forming a "vortex," a two-fluid flow-through system, and "Pb ENCASED e+" producing "Expanding Plasma." Caption: "Figure 12. Fluid Systems. (a) One-fluid system of LN2 or Ne propellant; (b) Two-fluid system of LH2 and LXe; (c) Two-fluid flow-through system...; and (d) One-fluid LH2 system with lead encapsulated Ps (courtesy Positronics Research LLC)."
